Third-party software in this folder
===================================

ffmpeg-0.12.10-st/ and ffmpeg-0.12.10-mt/
  ffmpeg.wasm core 0.12.10 (@ffmpeg/core and @ffmpeg/core-mt on npm),
  a WebAssembly build of FFmpeg 5.1 (libavcodec 59.37.100, libavformat
  59.27.100) with libx264, libx265, libvpx, libmp3lame, libtheora,
  libvorbis, libopus, zlib, libwebp, freetype, fribidi, libass and zimg.
  Because it includes GPL components it is distributed under the GNU
  General Public License, version 2 or later. The files here are the
  unmodified npm builds.

  Complete corresponding source and build scripts:
    https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.10
    https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ffmpeg/core/v/0.12.10
    https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ffmpeg/core-mt/v/0.12.10
    https://git.ffmpeg.org/gitweb/ffmpeg.git (release/5.1)
  License texts: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.html

../fonts/
  Fraunces (OFL-1.1) and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (OFL-1.1); license
  texts alongside the font files.
